data.title: Rising Waters
data.passage: Heavy rains fill mountain streams with rushing water very fast. To fix this, workers build high concrete walls along the riverbanks. Melting snow adds massive weight to the river channels. Instead, engineers create wide overflow basins to catch extra water safely. Constant heavy downpours overwhelm standard drainage systems completely. As a result, towns install giant pumps to push water away from homes.
